title: Montecito debris flows (Jan 8-9, 2018)
about: Modeled on the January 9, 2018 debris flows in Montecito, California. The people, teams and messages are invented; the scale, phases and problems follow the public record.
contentNote: This scenario includes fatalities, as the public record does: 23 people died. By default every casualty is softened to a critical injury. If the instructor chooses "as recorded", some radio traffic reports a deceased person, handled in radio protocol (no names, no cause, scene held, coroner notified). No names, addresses or photos of remains appear anywhere. Plan a short stress debrief after the class.
